paragraphs: I am a data analyst who works across banking, financial services and insurance, analyzing customer, account, transaction, claims and investment datasets with SQL.

My day-to-day work is validating and reconciling data between source systems and reports, then tracing mismatches to their root cause. At PNC this has helped reduce recurring data discrepancies by 21%.
